assumptions.text: The examples, tasks and glossary tables are still matched by fixed header position. Only the requirements table was changed, as C6 asks.
L12 is `captured` with check `none: judgment`, because no test for it exists.
L2's check cell reads `none: retired into L9`, and its text is `Merged into L9.`
The new ids are L11 for the id collision and L12 for the negative-example lesson.

A 'stated limit' is any `N unit` (digits, a space, a lowercase word) in the lesson. It is compared with `N unit` pairs in the constitution, matched by unit. If the constitution repeats a unit with different numbers, the last one wins.
If memory/constitution/constitution.md is missing, the limit check is skipped instead of failing.
The frozen tests were run with `uv run --with pytest --with markdown --with jsonschema pytest`. The repo has no declared pytest runner.
